features.text: Commits made in GitHub's web editor are signed off by GitHub.

status.live: the repository setting web_commit_signoff_required is true (set 2026-10-21)

features.text: Bot commands in issues and pull requests (`/status`, `/accept`, `/decline`, `/duplicate`, `/reproduce`, `/explain`): a triage command opens a pull request adding a record, and the issue follows the record once it lands.
`/track` turns an Ideas discussion or an objection to a decision into a tracker record.
A secret pasted into an issue is redacted by the publisher, with a comment saying why.
Issues, milestones and the project board generated from the harness's own records, with one Floor log comment per land.
The GitHub teams `triagers` and `reviewers`, applied from the role table.
